name: Geyser
description:
Sempie Craft is a friendly vanilla survival server where Bedrock and Java players play together on one world.

🏡 Land claims: protect your base with a golden shovel

📈 Playtime ranks: unlock perks like /hat, homes and bonus claim blocks

🎃 Events: like our Halloween Blood Moon with special rewards

🐴 Handy commands: /home, /tpa, call your horse with /horse

🗳️ Vote rewards: +50 claim blocks per vote

🛡️ Active staff, griefing gets rolled back

Mobile, Xbox, PlayStation, Switch and PC all welcome. Join with mc.sempie.nl, port 19132!
